knowledge.textEn: Tooth-passing frequency ft=z n/60; self-excited chatter needs phase and stability analysis.; Numbers label synthetic spectra, not approved cutting speeds; noncoincidence does not prove stability.

stages.title: 案例界面與資料可信度
stages.description: Sandvik Coromant 的銑削資料區分主軸轉速、每齒進給及切削速度。；畫四齒刀具角位置與每轉四次載荷脈衝，再對照合成頻譜。
stages.descriptionEn: Sandvik Coromant milling guidance distinguishes spindle speed, feed per tooth and cutting speed.; Draw four tooth positions and four load pulses per revolution, then compare a synthetic spectrum.
